course.title: Computer Science
course.description: Introduction to programming and computer science

programs.title: Program A: Python Foundations
programs.description: Build confidence with core Python logic, data structures, files, and classes.

starterPack.outcome: You will build reliable core coding habits and complete your first reusable analysis-ready scripts.
starterPack.badgeGoal: Foundation Badge: Complete modules 1-6 + milestone evidence

programs.title: Program B: Application Engineering
programs.description: Build production-style applications with validation, databases, APIs, and UI.

starterPack.outcome: You will ship integrated apps that validate, persist, serve, and visualize data end-to-end.
starterPack.badgeGoal: App Builder Badge: Complete modules 1-4 + integrated demo

programs.title: Program C: Data and AI Builder
programs.description: Apply analysis, testing, and AI-assisted engineering in cohesive projects.

starterPack.outcome: You will produce analyst-grade insights and AI-assisted engineering artifacts with evidence.
starterPack.badgeGoal: Data/AI Badge: Complete modules 1-3 + capstone evidence

assignments.title: Level 0: Python Basics
assignments.description: Variables, data types, conditionals, and loops

assignments.title: Level 1: String Validation and Data Quality
assignments.description: Validate email and phone formats using string methods, conditionals, and pattern detection

assignments.title: Level 2: Lists and Tuples
assignments.description: Master lists, tuples, indexing, slicing, and list methods for data collections

assignments.title: Level 3: Dictionaries and Sets
assignments.description: Learn key-value data storage with dictionaries and unique collections with sets

assignments.title: Level 4: Files and Exceptions
assignments.description: Read and write files, handle errors with try-except blocks for robust programs

assignments.title: Level 5: Python Classes
assignments.description: Defining and using classes in Python for object-oriented programming

assignments.title: Level 6: Data Analysis
assignments.description: Basics of data analysis: loading, exploring, and visualizing data in Python with pandas

assignments.title: Level 7: Testing with Pytest
assignments.description: Learn unit testing with pytest by covering normal behavior, edge cases, and invalid inputs

assignments.title: Level 8: Building REST APIs with FastAPI
assignments.description: Learn to build modern REST APIs with FastAPI framework, including CRUD operations and data validation

assignments.title: Level 9A: Agentic Software Engineering
assignments.description: Build a complete application using AI-assisted requirements, architecture, implementation, and testing workflow

assignments.title: Level 9: AI Analyst Workflow Lab
assignments.description: Use AI coding assistance with structured validation, review, and evidence-driven analyst workflows

assignments.title: Level 10: Data Parsing and Validation with Pydantic
assignments.description: Validate messy CSV and JSON data using strict Pydantic schemas and error reporting

assignments.title: Level 11: Database Programming with SQLAlchemy
assignments.description: Build an experiment tracker with SQLAlchemy ORM, SQLite, CRUD operations, and query summaries

assignments.title: Level 12: Web GUI with Streamlit
assignments.description: Create an interactive data dashboard with file upload, filters, charts, and summary insights

assignments.title: Level 13: KPI Design and Business Questions
assignments.description: Design decision-ready KPIs and business question trees that guide high-impact analysis

assignments.title: Level 14: Statistics and Hypothesis Testing
assignments.description: Run statistical tests and interpret uncertainty for evidence-based decisions

assignments.title: Level 15: Baseline Modeling and Evaluation
assignments.description: Build a reproducible baseline model and evaluate performance against benchmarks

assignments.title: Level 16: Data Communication and Storytelling
assignments.description: Communicate data findings through a concise recommendation memo for stakeholders
